# AccessBay Documentation

Canonical: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/
Full text: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/llms-full.txt

## Docs Index

- AccessBay documentation: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/
  Guides and reference for AccessBay, the self-hosted WordPress store for software licences and digital goods.
- Extension points: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/developers/extension-points/
  How other plugins can extend AccessBay, today and later.
- Hooks: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/developers/hooks/
  AccessBay's public actions and filters.
- Network calls: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/developers/network-calls/
  Every request AccessBay and the AccessBay SDK make over the network, when they make it, and what each one sends.
- REST conventions: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/developers/rest-conventions/
  The rules every AccessBay REST route follows, including authentication, errors, retries, rate limits and headers.
- SDK: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/developers/sdk/
  Add AccessBay licensing to your own WordPress plugin with the SDK. Install it, prefix it, configure it, test it and release it.
- Email setup: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/email/
  How AccessBay sends email, how to add email providers, what happens when one fails, and what the email logs keep.
- Health checks: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/health-checks/
  What AccessBay checks about its own server, where to see the results, and how to point an uptime monitor at it.
- Installation: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/installation/
  Install and activate AccessBay, what activation sets up, and what deactivating or deleting it removes.
- Introduction: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/introduction/
  What AccessBay is, who it is for, and what works in the current pre-release.
- Known limits: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/known-limits/
  What this release of AccessBay leaves out, and how updating from one release to the next is meant to work.
- Licence: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/licence/
  The licences AccessBay and its client SDK are released under, what they mean for plugins you build with the SDK, and how to get the source.
- Plugin settings: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/plugin-settings/
  Show AccessBay in the admin bar, choose whether deleting the plugin deletes its data, and erase all AccessBay data while keeping the plugin.
- Brevo: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/providers/brevo/
  How to connect Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) to AccessBay - authenticate a domain, create an API key, fill in the form and set up delivery events.
- Mailgun: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/providers/mailgun/
  How to connect Mailgun to AccessBay - add and verify a domain, get an API key, fill in the form and set up delivery events.
- Email providers: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/providers/overview/
  Which email provider to choose for AccessBay, where the webhook URL is shown, how to test, and a setup page for each provider.
- Postmark: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/providers/postmark/
  How to connect Postmark to AccessBay - confirm a sender, copy the server API token, fill in the form and set up delivery events.
- Resend: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/providers/resend/
  How to connect Resend to AccessBay - verify a domain, create a sending-only API key, fill in the form and set up delivery events.
- Twilio SendGrid: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/providers/sendgrid/
  How to connect Twilio SendGrid to AccessBay - verify a sender, create an API key, fill in the form and set up delivery events.
- SMTP: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/providers/smtp/
  How to connect any SMTP server to AccessBay - Google Workspace and Gmail, Microsoft 365, or your host's mailbox.
- SMTP2GO: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/providers/smtp2go/
  How to connect SMTP2GO to AccessBay - verify a sender, create an API key, fill in the form and set up delivery events.
- WordPress (wp_mail): https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/providers/wp-mail/
  How the WordPress mail provider works in AccessBay, and how to use it with WP Mail SMTP, FluentSMTP or a similar plugin.
- ZeptoMail: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/providers/zeptomail/
  How to connect ZeptoMail (Zoho) to AccessBay - verify a domain, copy the Send Mail token and fill in the form. Delivery events are not available.
- Requirements: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/requirements/
  The WordPress, PHP and database versions AccessBay needs, and the PHP extensions it checks for.
- The secret key: https://docs.wpanchorbay.com/accessbay/guide/secret-key/
  Set ACCESSBAY_SECRET before going live, what happens without it, and how to change it safely.
